items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Aunt Eula and Uncle John's children, they and their children would go with us to pick cotton

ctx.x: And when he died, I remember that old, brown, wooden casket, and somebody picked me up and held me there to see him, you know. And I kept saying, 'Why doesn't he wake up and take me to get some candy,' you know, even though he was gone.

But we were surrounded with that music down there. The Glascos, who I was speaking of before, Aunt Eula and Uncle John's children, they and their children would go with us to pick cotton, out at the farm where my father worked year-round, see. And --
